research_question: Can the P3d layered decision be expressed as a framework-neutral, fail-closed receipt schema and dependency-light validator suitable for freezing before final-blind corpus selection?
claim_boundary: Administrative/mechanism self-test only. A valid receipt proves schema consistency and recorded checks, not universal replay correctness or unseen-framework generalization.

none.use: contract-inference or non-replay candidate; capability status must be unsupported unless a future version defines another mechanism

requirements: every replay receipt has at least one primary_input
stored_parameter_record receipts have at least one parameter_record operand so the validated record bytes are bound
every target-dependent name must appear as a lineage operand; primary_input is allowed for shape/content dependence on the primary sample, while external metadata must use metadata_target
all digests are 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters

composition_policy: semantic reject dominates and returns reject
semantic admit plus capability unsupported returns unsupported
semantic admit plus capability unknown returns unknown
semantic admit plus capability supported plus source unknown returns unknown
only semantic admit plus capability supported plus source supported returns admit
self_tests: false required check cannot claim capability Supported
native/source Unknown cannot compose to Admit
mechanism none cannot claim capability Supported
unknown field rejected in strict mode
success_gates: JSON schema and Python validator agree on both valid receipt fixtures
all invalid receipt fixtures fail closed with a named reason
all eight composition truth-table cases pass
validator imports and self-tests without PyTorch, imgaug, Albumentations or OpenCV
P3d and P4a frozen inputs remain unchanged
falsification_rules: Do not embed framework-specific class or method names in the core validator.
Framework adapters may populate checks, but cannot redefine composition precedence.
A receipt with check=false cannot be Supported even if exact_replay=true.
Schema validation is evidence hygiene, not a proof that measured outputs cover future inputs.
If a self-test fails, retain v0 and create a new protocol before relaxing required fields or checks.
